verses.original: Καὶ προσκαλεσάμενος τοὺς δώδεκα μαθητὰς αὐτοῦ ἔδωκεν αὐτοῖς ἐξουσίαν πνευμάτων ἀκαθάρτων ὥστε ἐκβάλλειν αὐτὰ καὶ θεραπεύειν πᾶσαν νόσον καὶ πᾶσαν μαλακίαν
verses.transliteration: Kai proskalesamenos tous dōdeka mathētas autou edōken autois exousian pneumatōn akathartōn hōste ekballein auta kai therapeuein pasan noson kai pasan malakian
verses.literal: And calling His twelve disciples to Him Jesus gave them authority over unclean spirits so that they could drive them out . . . and heal every disease and sickness
verses.literalPt: Depois de reunir Jesus os seus doze discípulos, deu-lhes poder sobre os espíritos imundos, para os expelirem e para curarem todas as doenças e enfermidades.

verses.original: Τῶν δὲ δώδεκα ἀποστόλων τὰ ὀνόματά ἐστιν ταῦτα πρῶτος Σίμων ὁ λεγόμενος Πέτρος καὶ Ἀνδρέας ὁ ἀδελφὸς αὐτοῦ καὶ Ἰάκωβος ὁ τοῦ Ζεβεδαίου καὶ Ἰωάννης ὁ ἀδελφὸς αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Tōn de dōdeka apostolōn ta onomata estin tauta prōtos Simōn ho legomenos Petros kai Andreas ho adelphos autou kai Iakōbos ho tou Zebedaiou kai Iōannēs ho adelphos autou
verses.literal: These are the names of the twelve apostles first Simon called Peter and his brother Andrew James son of Zebedee and his brother John
verses.literalPt: Ora, os nomes dos doze apóstolos são estes: O primeiro, Simão, que também se chama Pedro, e André, seu irmão; Tiago e João, filhos de Zebedeu;

verses.original: Φίλιππος καὶ Βαρθολομαῖος Θωμᾶς καὶ Μαθθαῖος ὁ τελώνης Ἰάκωβος ὁ τοῦ Ἁλφαίου καὶ Θαδδαῖος
verses.transliteration: Philippos kai Bartholomaios Thōmas kai Maththaios ho telōnēs Iakōbos ho tou Halphaiou kai Thaddaios
verses.literal: Philip and Bartholomew Thomas and Matthew the tax collector James son of Alphaeus and Thaddaeus
verses.literalPt: Filipe e Bartolomeu; Tomé e Mateus, o publicano; Tiago, filho de Alfeu, e Tadeu;

verses.original: Σίμων ὁ Καναναῖος καὶ Ἰούδας ὁ Ἰσκαριώτης ὁ καὶ παραδοὺς αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: Simōn ho Kananaios kai Ioudas ho Iskariōtēs ho kai paradous auton
verses.literal: Simon the Zealot and Judas Iscariot who betrayed Jesus
verses.literalPt: Simão, o zelote, e Judas Iscariotes, que o traiu.

verses.original: Τούτους τοὺς δώδεκα ἀπέστειλεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς παραγγείλας αὐτοῖς λέγων Εἰς ὁδὸν ἐθνῶν μὴ ἀπέλθητε καὶ εἰς πόλιν Σαμαριτῶν μὴ εἰσέλθητε
verses.transliteration: Toutous tous dōdeka apesteilen ho Iēsous parangeilas autois legōn Eis hodon ethnōn mē apelthēte kai eis polin Samaritōn mē eiselthēte
verses.literal: These twelve Jesus sent out with the following instructions Do not go onto the road of the Gentiles or enter . . . . . . any town of the Samaritans
verses.literalPt: A esses doze enviou Jesus, dando-lhes estas instruções: Não ireis aos gentios, nem entrareis nas cidades dos samaritanos;

verses.original: πορεύεσθε δὲ μᾶλλον πρὸς τὰ πρόβατα τὰ ἀπολωλότα οἴκου Ἰσραήλ
verses.transliteration: poreuesthe de mallon pros ta probata ta apolōlota oikou Israēl
verses.literal: Go rather to the lost sheep of Israel
verses.literalPt: mas ide, antes, às ovelhas perdidas da casa de Israel.

verses.original: πορευόμενοι δὲ κηρύσσετε λέγοντες ὅτι Ἤγγικεν ἡ βασιλεία τῶν οὐρανῶν
verses.transliteration: poreuomenoi de kēryssete legontes hoti Ēngiken hē basileia tōn ouranōn
verses.literal: As you go preach this message The kingdom of heaven is near
verses.literalPt: Pondo-vos a caminho, pregai que está próximo o reino dos céus.

verses.original: ἀσθενοῦντας θεραπεύετε νεκροὺς ἐγείρετε λεπροὺς καθαρίζετε δαιμόνια ἐκβάλλετε δωρεὰν ἐλάβετε δωρεὰν δότε
verses.transliteration: asthenountas therapeuete nekrous egeirete leprous katharizete daimonia ekballete dōrean elabete dōrean dote
verses.literal: Heal the sick raise the dead cleanse the lepers drive out demons Freely you have received freely give
verses.literalPt: Curai os enfermos, ressuscitai os mortos, limpai os leprosos, expeli os demônios; de graça recebestes, de graça dai.

verses.original: Μὴ κτήσησθε χρυσὸν μηδὲ ἄργυρον μηδὲ χαλκὸν εἰς τὰς ζώνας ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: Mē ktēsēsthe chryson mēde argyron mēde chalkon eis tas zōnas hymōn
verses.literal: Do not take along any gold or silver or copper in your belts
verses.literalPt: Não vos provereis de ouro, nem de prata, nem de cobre nas vossas bolsas;

verses.original: μὴ πήραν εἰς ὁδὸν μηδὲ δύο χιτῶνας μηδὲ ὑποδήματα μηδὲ ῥάβδον ἄξιος γὰρ ὁ ἐργάτης τῆς τροφῆς αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: mē pēran eis hodon mēde dyo chitōnas mēde hypodēmata mēde rhabdon axios gar ho ergatēs tēs trophēs autou
verses.literal: Take no bag for the road or second tunic or sandals or staff for the worker is worthy of his provisions
verses.literalPt: nem de alforje para o caminho, nem de duas túnicas, nem de calçado, nem de bordão; pois digno é o trabalhador do seu alimento.

verses.original: Εἰς ἣν δ’ ἂν πόλιν ἢ κώμην εἰσέλθητε ἐξετάσατε τίς ἐν αὐτῇ ἄξιός ἐστιν κἀκεῖ μείνατε ἕως ἂν ἐξέλθητε
verses.transliteration: Eis hēn d’ an polin ē kōmēn eiselthēte exetasate tis en autē axios estin kakei meinate heōs an exelthēte
verses.literal: Whatever . . . town or village you enter find out who is worthy there . . . and stay at his house until . . . you move on
verses.literalPt: Em qualquer cidade ou aldeia em que entrardes, indagai quem nela é digno; e aí ficai até vos retirardes.

verses.original: εἰσερχόμενοι δὲ εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν ἀσπάσασθε αὐτήν
verses.transliteration: eiserchomenoi de eis tēn oikian aspasasthe autēn
verses.literal: As you enter . . . the home greet its occupants
verses.literalPt: Ao entrardes na casa, saudai-a;

verses.original: καὶ ἐὰν μὲν ᾖ ἡ οἰκία ἀξία ἐλθάτω ἡ εἰρήνη ὑμῶν ἐπ’ αὐτήν ἐὰν δὲ μὴ ᾖ ἀξία ἡ εἰρήνη ὑμῶν πρὸς ὑμᾶς ἐπιστραφήτω
verses.transliteration: kai ean men ē hē oikia axia elthatō hē eirēnē hymōn ep’ autēn ean de mē ē axia hē eirēnē hymōn pros hymas epistraphētō
verses.literal: If the home is worthy let your peace rest on it but if it is not let your peace return to you
verses.literalPt: se ela for digna, desça sobre ela a vossa paz; mas, se o não for, torne para vós a vossa paz.

verses.original: καὶ ὃς ἂν μὴ δέξηται ὑμᾶς μηδὲ ἀκούσῃ τοὺς λόγους ὑμῶν ἐξερχόμενοι ἔξω τῆς οἰκίας ἢ τῆς πόλεως ἐκείνης ἐκτινάξατε τὸν κονιορτὸν τῶν ποδῶν ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: kai hos an mē dexētai hymas mēde akousē tous logous hymōn exerchomenoi exō tēs oikias ē tēs poleōs ekeinēs ektinaxate ton koniorton tōn podōn hymōn
verses.literal: And if anyone . . . will not welcome you or heed your words shake the dust off your feet when you leave . . . that home or town
verses.literalPt: Se alguém não vos receber, nem ouvir as vossas palavras, ao sairdes daquela casa ou daquela cidade, sacudi o pó dos vossos pés.

verses.original: ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ἀνεκτότερον ἔσται γῇ Σοδόμων καὶ Γομόρρων ἐν ἡμέρᾳ κρίσεως ἢ τῇ πόλει ἐκείνῃ
verses.transliteration: amēn legō hymin anektoteron estai gē Sodomōn kai Gomorrōn en hēmera kriseōs ē tē polei ekeinē
verses.literal: Truly I tell you it will be more bearable for Sodom and Gomorrah on the day of judgment than for that town
verses.literalPt: Em verdade vos digo que, no dia de juízo, haverá menos rigor para a terra de Sodoma e de Gomorra do que para aquela cidade.

verses.original: Ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἀποστέλλω ὑμᾶς ὡς πρόβατα ἐν μέσῳ λύκων γίνεσθε οὖν φρόνιμοι ὡς οἱ ὄφεις καὶ ἀκέραιοι ὡς αἱ περιστεραί
verses.transliteration: Idou egō apostellō hymas hōs probata en mesō lykōn ginesthe oun phronimoi hōs hoi opheis kai akeraioi hōs hai peristerai
verses.literal: Behold I am sending you out . . . like sheep among . . . wolves therefore be as shrewd as snakes and as innocent as doves
verses.literalPt: Eu vos envio como ovelhas no meio de lobos; sede, pois, prudentes como as serpentes e simples como as pombas.

verses.original: Προσέχετε δὲ ἀπὸ τῶν ἀνθρώπων παραδώσουσιν γὰρ ὑμᾶς εἰς συνέδρια καὶ ἐν ταῖς συναγωγαῖς αὐτῶν μαστιγώσουσιν ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: Prosechete de apo tōn anthrōpōn paradōsousin gar hymas eis synedria kai en tais synagōgais autōn mastigōsousin hymas
verses.literal: But beware of men for they will hand you over . . . to their councils and flog you in their synagogues
verses.literalPt: Guardai-vos, porém, dos homens; porque vos entregarão aos tribunais e vos açoitarão nas suas sinagogas;

verses.original: καὶ ἐπὶ ἡγεμόνας δὲ καὶ βασιλεῖς ἀχθήσεσθε ἕνεκεν ἐμοῦ εἰς μαρτύριον αὐτοῖς καὶ τοῖς ἔθνεσιν
verses.transliteration: kai epi hēgemonas de kai basileis achthēsesthe heneken emou eis martyrion autois kai tois ethnesin
verses.literal: On My account . . . you will be brought before governors and kings as witnesses to them and to the Gentiles
verses.literalPt: por minha causa sereis levados à presença dos governadores e dos reis, para lhes servir de testemunho, a eles e aos gentios.

verses.original: ὅταν δὲ παραδῶσιν ὑμᾶς μὴ μεριμνήσητε πῶς ἢ τί λαλήσητε δοθήσεται γὰρ ὑμῖν ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ὥρᾳ τί λαλήσητε
verses.transliteration: hotan de paradōsin hymas mē merimnēsēte pōs ē ti lalēsēte dothēsetai gar hymin en ekeinē tē hōra ti lalēsēte
verses.literal: But when they hand you over . . . do not worry about how to respond or what to say In that hour you will be given what to say
verses.literalPt: Mas, quando vos entregarem, não cuideis como ou o que haveis de falar, porque naquela hora vos será dado o que haveis de dizer.

verses.original: οὐ γὰρ ὑμεῖς ἐστε οἱ λαλοῦντες ἀλλὰ τὸ Πνεῦμα τοῦ Πατρὸς ὑμῶν τὸ λαλοῦν ἐν ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: ou gar hymeis este hoi lalountes alla to Pneuma tou Patros hymōn to laloun en hymin
verses.literal: For it will not be . . . you speaking but the Spirit of your Father speaking through you
verses.literalPt: Pois não sois vós os que falais, mas é o Espírito de vosso Pai o que fala em vós.

verses.original: Παραδώσει δὲ ἀδελφὸς ἀδελφὸν εἰς θάνατον καὶ πατὴρ τέκνον καὶ ἐπαναστήσονται τέκνα ἐπὶ γονεῖς καὶ θανατώσουσιν αὐτούς
verses.transliteration: Paradōsei de adelphos adelphon eis thanaton kai patēr teknon kai epanastēsontai tekna epi goneis kai thanatōsousin autous
verses.literal: Brother will betray brother to death and a father his child children will rise against their parents and have them put to death . . .
verses.literalPt: Irmãos entregarão à morte a irmãos, e pais, a filhos; filhos se levantarão contra seus pais e os farão morrer.

verses.original: καὶ ἔσεσθε μισούμενοι ὑπὸ πάντων διὰ τὸ ὄνομά μου ὁ δὲ ὑπομείνας εἰς τέλος οὗτος σωθήσεται
verses.transliteration: kai esesthe misoumenoi hypo pantōn dia to onoma mou ho de hypomeinas eis telos houtos sōthēsetai
verses.literal: You will be hated by everyone because of My name but the one who perseveres to the end will be saved
verses.literalPt: Sereis odiados de todos por causa do meu nome; mas quem perseverar até o fim, esse será salvo.

verses.original: Ὅταν δὲ διώκωσιν ὑμᾶς ἐν τῇ πόλει ταύτῃ φεύγετε εἰς τὴν ἑτέραν ἀμὴν γὰρ λέγω ὑμῖν οὐ μὴ τελέσητε τὰς πόλεις τοῦ Ἰσραὴλ ἕως ἂν ἔλθῃ ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου
verses.transliteration: Hotan de diōkōsin hymas en tē polei tautē pheugete eis tēn heteran amēn gar legō hymin ou mē telesēte tas poleis tou Israēl heōs an elthē ho Huios tou anthrōpou
verses.literal: When they persecute you in one town flee to the next Truly I tell you you will not reach . . . . . . all the towns of Israel before . . . the Son of Man comes
verses.literalPt: Quando, porém, vos perseguirem numa cidade, fugi para outra; porque em verdade vos digo que não acabareis de percorrer as cidades de Israel, antes que venha o Filho do Homem.

verses.original: Οὐκ ἔστιν μαθητὴς ὑπὲρ τὸν διδάσκαλον οὐδὲ δοῦλος ὑπὲρ τὸν κύριον αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Ouk estin mathētēs hyper ton didaskalon oude doulos hyper ton kyrion autou
verses.literal: A disciple is not above his teacher nor a servant above his master
verses.literalPt: Não é o discípulo mais que o seu mestre, nem o servo mais que o seu senhor.

verses.original: ἀρκετὸν τῷ μαθητῇ ἵνα γένηται ὡς ὁ διδάσκαλος αὐτοῦ καὶ ὁ δοῦλος ὡς ὁ κύριος αὐτοῦ εἰ τὸν οἰκοδεσπότην Βεελζεβοὺλ ἐπεκάλεσαν πόσῳ μᾶλλον τοὺς οἰκιακοὺς αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: arketon tō mathētē hina genētai hōs ho didaskalos autou kai ho doulos hōs ho kyrios autou ei ton oikodespotēn Beelzeboul epekalesan posō mallon tous oikiakous autou
verses.literal: It is enough for a disciple to be like his teacher and a servant like his master If the head of the house has been called Beelzebul how much more the members of his household
verses.literalPt: Basta ao discípulo ser como o seu mestre, e ao servo, como o seu senhor. Se chamaram Belzebu ao dono da casa, quanto mais aos seus domésticos?

verses.original: Μὴ οὖν φοβηθῆτε αὐτούς οὐδὲν γάρ ἐστιν κεκαλυμμένον ὃ οὐκ ἀποκαλυφθήσεται καὶ κρυπτὸν ὃ οὐ γνωσθήσεται
verses.transliteration: Mē oun phobēthēte autous ouden gar estin kekalymmenon ho ouk apokalyphthēsetai kai krypton ho ou gnōsthēsetai
verses.literal: So do not be afraid . . . of them For there is nothing concealed that will not be disclosed and nothing hidden that will not be made known . . .
verses.literalPt: Portanto, não os temais; pois nada há encoberto que se não venha a descobrir; nem oculto, que se não venha a saber.

verses.original: ὃ λέγω ὑμῖν ἐν τῇ σκοτίᾳ εἴπατε ἐν τῷ φωτί καὶ ὃ εἰς τὸ οὖς ἀκούετε κηρύξατε ἐπὶ τῶν δωμάτων
verses.transliteration: ho legō hymin en tē skotia eipate en tō phōti kai ho eis to ous akouete kēryxate epi tōn dōmatōn
verses.literal: What I tell you in the dark speak in the daylight what is whispered in your ear proclaim from the housetops
verses.literalPt: O que vos digo às escuras, dizei-o às claras; e o que se vos diz ao ouvido, proclamai-o dos eirados.

verses.original: Καὶ μὴ φοβεῖσθε ἀπὸ τῶν ἀποκτεννόντων τὸ σῶμα τὴν δὲ ψυχὴν μὴ δυναμένων ἀποκτεῖναι φοβεῖσθε δὲ μᾶλλον τὸν δυνάμενον καὶ ψυχὴν καὶ σῶμα ἀπολέσαι ἐν γεέννῃ
verses.transliteration: Kai mē phobeisthe apo tōn apoktennontōn to sōma tēn de psychēn mē dynamenōn apokteinai phobeisthe de mallon ton dynamenon kai psychēn kai sōma apolesai en geennē
verses.literal: Do not be afraid . . . of those who kill the body but cannot . . . kill the soul Instead fear the One who can destroy both soul and body in hell
verses.literalPt: Não temais aos que matam o corpo, mas não podem matar a alma; temei, antes, aquele que pode fazer perecer na Geena tanto a alma como o corpo.

verses.original: Οὐχὶ δύο στρουθία ἀσσαρίου πωλεῖται καὶ ἓν ἐξ αὐτῶν οὐ πεσεῖται ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν ἄνευ τοῦ Πατρὸς ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: Ouchi dyo strouthia assariou pōleitai kai hen ex autōn ou peseitai epi tēn gēn aneu tou Patros hymōn
verses.literal: Are not two sparrows sold for a penny Yet not one of them will fall to the ground apart from the will of your Father
verses.literalPt: Não se vendem dois passarinhos por um asse? e nenhum deles cairá no chão senão pela vontade de vosso Pai.

verses.original: ὑμῶν δὲ καὶ αἱ τρίχες τῆς κεφαλῆς πᾶσαι ἠριθμημέναι εἰσίν
verses.transliteration: hymōn de kai hai triches tēs kephalēs pasai ērithmēmenai eisin
verses.literal: And even the very hairs of your head are all numbered
verses.literalPt: Quanto a vós, até os cabelos da vossa cabeça estão todos contados.

verses.original: μὴ οὖν φοβεῖσθε πολλῶν στρουθίων διαφέρετε ὑμεῖς
verses.transliteration: mē oun phobeisthe pollōn strouthiōn diapherete hymeis
verses.literal: So do not be afraid . . . you are worth more than many sparrows
verses.literalPt: Não temais, pois; mais valeis vós que muitos passarinhos.

verses.original: Πᾶς οὖν ὅστις ὁμολογήσει ἐν ἐμοὶ ἔμπροσθεν τῶν ἀνθρώπων ὁμολογήσω κἀγὼ ἐν αὐτῷ ἔμπροσθεν τοῦ Πατρός μου τοῦ ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς
verses.transliteration: Pas oun hostis homologēsei en emoi emprosthen tōn anthrōpōn homologēsō kagō en autō emprosthen tou Patros mou tou en tois ouranois
verses.literal: Therefore everyone who confesses . . . Me before men I will also confess . . . him before My Father in heaven
verses.literalPt: Portanto, todo aquele que me confessar diante dos homens, também eu o confessarei diante de meu Pai, que está nos céus;

verses.original: ὅστις δ’ ἂν ἀρνήσηταί με ἔμπροσθεν τῶν ἀνθρώπων ἀρνήσομαι κἀγὼ αὐτὸν ἔμπροσθεν τοῦ Πατρός μου τοῦ ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς
verses.transliteration: hostis d’ an arnēsētai me emprosthen tōn anthrōpōn arnēsomai kagō auton emprosthen tou Patros mou tou en tois ouranois
verses.literal: But whoever . . . denies Me before men I will also deny him before My Father in heaven
verses.literalPt: mas aquele que me negar diante dos homens, também eu o negarei diante de meu Pai, que está nos céus.

verses.original: Μὴ νομίσητε ὅτι ἦλθον βαλεῖν εἰρήνην ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν οὐκ ἦλθον βαλεῖν εἰρήνην ἀλλὰ μάχαιραν
verses.transliteration: Mē nomisēte hoti ēlthon balein eirēnēn epi tēn gēn ouk ēlthon balein eirēnēn alla machairan
verses.literal: Do not assume that I have come to bring peace to the earth I have not come . . . to bring peace but a sword
verses.literalPt: Não penseis que vim trazer paz à terra; não vim trazer paz, mas espada.

verses.original: ἦλθον γὰρ διχάσαι Ἄνθρωπον κατὰ τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ Καὶ θυγατέρα κατὰ τῆς μητρὸς αὐτῆς Καὶ νύμφην κατὰ τῆς πενθερᾶς αὐτῆς
verses.transliteration: ēlthon gar dichasai Anthrōpon kata tou patros autou Kai thygatera kata tēs mētros autēs Kai nymphēn kata tēs pentheras autēs
verses.literal: For I have come to turn a man against his father a daughter against her mother a daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law
verses.literalPt: Pois vim causar divisão entre o filho e seu pai, entre a filha e sua mãe e entre a nora e sua sogra.

verses.original: Καὶ ἐχθροὶ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου οἱ οἰκιακοὶ αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Kai echthroi tou anthrōpou hoi oikiakoi autou
verses.literal: A man’s enemies will be the members of his own household
verses.literalPt: Assim, os inimigos do homem serão os da sua própria casa.

verses.original: Ὁ φιλῶν πατέρα ἢ μητέρα ὑπὲρ ἐμὲ οὐκ ἔστιν μου ἄξιος καὶ ὁ φιλῶν υἱὸν ἢ θυγατέρα ὑπὲρ ἐμὲ οὐκ ἔστιν μου ἄξιος
verses.transliteration: Ho philōn patera ē mētera hyper eme ouk estin mou axios kai ho philōn huion ē thygatera hyper eme ouk estin mou axios
verses.literal: Anyone who loves his father or mother more than Me is not worthy of Me anyone who loves his son or daughter more than Me is not worthy of Me
verses.literalPt: Quem ama seu pai ou sua mãe mais do que a mim não é digno de mim; quem ama seu filho ou sua filha mais do que a mim, não é digno de mim;

verses.original: καὶ ὃς οὐ λαμβάνει τὸν σταυρὸν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀκολουθεῖ ὀπίσω μου οὐκ ἔστιν μου ἄξιος
verses.transliteration: kai hos ou lambanei ton stauron autou kai akolouthei opisō mou ouk estin mou axios
verses.literal: and anyone who does not take up . . . his cross and follow Me is not worthy of Me
verses.literalPt: e aquele que não toma a sua cruz e não me segue não é digno de mim.

verses.original: ὁ εὑρὼν τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ ἀπολέσει αὐτήν καὶ ὁ ἀπολέσας τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ ἕνεκεν ἐμοῦ εὑρήσει αὐτήν
verses.transliteration: ho heurōn tēn psychēn autou apolesei autēn kai ho apolesas tēn psychēn autou heneken emou heurēsei autēn
verses.literal: Whoever finds his life will lose it and whoever loses his life for My sake . . . will find it
verses.literalPt: O que acha a sua vida perdê-la-á; mas o que perde a sua vida por minha causa achá-la-á.

verses.original: Ὁ δεχόμενος ὑμᾶς ἐμὲ δέχεται καὶ ὁ ἐμὲ δεχόμενος δέχεται τὸν ἀποστείλαντά με
verses.transliteration: Ho dechomenos hymas eme dechetai kai ho eme dechomenos dechetai ton aposteilanta me
verses.literal: He who receives you receives Me and he who receives Me receives the One who sent Me
verses.literalPt: Aquele que vos recebe a mim me recebe; e aquele que me recebe recebe aquele que me enviou.

verses.original: ὁ δεχόμενος προφήτην εἰς ὄνομα προφήτου μισθὸν προφήτου λήμψεται καὶ ὁ δεχόμενος δίκαιον εἰς ὄνομα δικαίου μισθὸν δικαίου λήμψεται
verses.transliteration: ho dechomenos prophētēn eis onoma prophētou misthon prophētou lēmpsetai kai ho dechomenos dikaion eis onoma dikaiou misthon dikaiou lēmpsetai
verses.literal: Whoever receives a prophet because he is . . . a prophet will receive a prophet’s reward and whoever receives a righteous man because he is . . . a righteous man will receive a righteous man’s reward
verses.literalPt: Quem recebe um profeta, por ser profeta, receberá a recompensa de profeta; e quem recebe um justo, por ser justo, receberá a recompensa de justo.

verses.original: καὶ ὃς ἂν ποτίσῃ ἕνα τῶν μικρῶν τούτων ποτήριον ψυχροῦ μόνον εἰς ὄνομα μαθητοῦ ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν οὐ μὴ ἀπολέσῃ τὸν μισθὸν αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: kai hos an potisē hena tōn mikrōn toutōn potērion psychrou monon eis onoma mathētou amēn legō hymin ou mē apolesē ton misthon autou
verses.literal: And if anyone . . . gives even a cup of cold water to one of these little ones because he is My disciple truly I tell you he will never lose . . . . . . his reward
verses.literalPt: Aquele que der de beber, ainda que seja um copo de água fria, a um destes pequeninos, por ser meu discípulo, em verdade vos digo que de modo algum perderá a sua recompensa.
